name: Soybean meal; regional mix with Brazilian soy; at feed compound plant
description: Approximation for the contribution of soybean meal from Brazil in the commodity market for soybean meal fed to swine.

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This unit process represents a soybean feed mix with soy sourced from the specified region (U.S. swine production regions, see supporting documentation) and Brazil.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: This process produces soybean meal feed, at farm.  This process requires upstream flows from the Agri-Footprint dataset.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Upstream unit processes for the five USDA soybean meal production regions are aggregated to represent the regionally produced feed mix for the state of Iowa.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: This is a unit process for aggregated U.S. regions and Brazil. Background unit processes include domestic soymeal production (96% of total), which was modeled as the U.S. weighted average of production regions. Imported soybean meal (4%) was Agri-footprint database unit process "Soybean meal, from crushing (solvent), at plant/BR Economic"
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Flow values within this dataset were obtained from a variety of sources, including the 2007 NASS Census of Agriculture and process model simulations of the pig production process (see supporting documentation).
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data for this project was collected from 2007 to 2014. Unit process data were compiled in 2014.

reviews.details: Data for this project was collected from 2007 to 2014. Unit process data were compiled in 2014.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.

publication.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios
